# What a pack costs to make and send

> The lines of the budget, each with what to fill in and where the figure comes from. Every amount starts at nothing: none of them is guessed.
>
> This is the starting draft that ships with the back end, as it was written. The copy people work from is in the back end, under [Plans, Budget](https://quickpickle.vercel.app/backstage/plans/budget), and may have been changed there since. This file does not follow those changes.

## Per shot

Paid once for every bottle: what is in it and what it is in.

- **Juice.** What the juice in one 100 ml shot costs. From the maker's quote or invoice, divided by the number of shots a batch really gives.
- **Bottle.** One bottle, from the supplier's quote. Include the freight to get them to you, shared across the order.
- **Cap.** One cap, and any seal or liner, from the supplier's quote. Leave at nothing if the bottle price already includes it.
- **Label.** One printed label, from the printer's quote for the run you would really order.
- **Making and filling.** What it costs to make, fill, cap and label one shot, if that is not already in the juice price: a contract maker's charge, or kitchen hire and paid help divided by the shots made.

## Per pack

Paid once for every pack sold, whatever its size.

- **Carton.** The box one pack goes in. This is one figure for every pack size. If the boxes differ a lot, enter the dearest so the sums stay cautious.
- **Sticker or card.** Anything that goes in every pack: a sticker, a card. Leave at nothing if there is none.

## Per order

Paid once for every order sent.

- **Courier.** What the courier charges us to send one parcel to a town address. From the courier's quote. Rural costs more, and the customer pays a rural extra on top.
- **Packing materials.** The outer box or bag, padding, tape and courier label for one parcel.
- **Card fee, fixed part.** The fixed amount the payment company takes on each payment, if it charges one. From Stripe's price list for New Zealand.

## Share of each sale

A percentage of everything the customer pays, delivery included.

- **Card fee, share of the payment.** The percentage the payment company takes of each payment. From Stripe's price list for New Zealand cards. Enter it as a percentage.

## Per month

Paid every month whether anything sells or not.

- **Hosting and database.** What the site's hosting and database cost a month once they are on a plan that allows taking money.
- **Email service.** The monthly charge for sending and receiving the business's email, if there is one.
- **Domain name.** The yearly cost of the domain name, divided by 12.
- **Accounting software.** The monthly cost of Xero, or whatever keeps the books.
- **Food registration and verification.** The yearly cost of registering and of the verifier's visits, divided by 12. Ask the council or your verifier.
- **Insurance.** The yearly premium divided by 12, if there is cover.
